tasks.name: repair_clamp

files.src/clamp.cjs: exports.clamp = (x, low, high) => Math.min(low, Math.max(high, x));
files.test.cjs: const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const {clamp} = require('./src/clamp.cjs'); assert.equal(clamp(5,0,10),5); assert.equal(clamp(-2,0,10),0); assert.equal(clamp(12,0,10),10);

tasks.prompt: Fix src/clamp.cjs so clamp(x, low, high) returns x within inclusive bounds. Preserve the exported API. Run node test.cjs and report the result. Do not edit the tests.

tasks.name: repair_pagination

files.src/page.cjs: exports.page = (items, offset, limit) => items.slice(offset, offset + limit - 1);
files.test.cjs: const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const {page} = require('./src/page.cjs'); assert.deepEqual(page([1,2,3,4,5],1,3),[2,3,4]); assert.deepEqual(page([1,2],0,0),[]);

tasks.prompt: The pagination function under src/ drops the last requested item. Find and fix the implementation, preserving the API. Offset and limit are nonnegative integers. Run node test.cjs. Do not edit the tests.
